note: Rejudged 2026-10-22 by independent route-policy auditor. RFC 4271 Section 5.1.4: "If a BGP speaker is configured to alter the value of the MULTI_EXIT_DISC attribute received over EBGP, then altering the value MUST be done prior to determining the degree of preference of the route and prior to performing route selection (Decision Process phases 1 and 2)." Preserve the existing single-polarity positive ordering scope. Read reactor/rfc4271_med_ingress_test.go::TestRFC4271ReceivedMEDAlteredBeforeTheDecisionProcess and reactor/rfc4271_test.go::TestRFC4271MEDAlterationHappensAtIngress. The former supplies an EBGP UPDATE carrying MED 100 to notifyMessageReceiver, runs the configured med-10 policy seam, requires exactly one received dispatch, and asserts exact 0000000A in both RawBytes and WireUpdate.Payload. The latter checks safeIngressFilter returns rewritten bytes and is supplementary, not independent proof of dispatch ordering. Producers: filter_ordered.go::runIngressPolicyChain applies PolicyFilterChain and rebuilds the text delta; reactor_notify.go::notifyMessageReceiver consumes modifiedPayload and replaces RawMessage fields before cache insertion and receiver delivery. The typed ImportPolicy constructed with FinalAccept preserves the previous chain exhaustion acceptance and the asserted MED change; it does not change the seam or assertion. Retain enforced for alteration before the decision-process input boundary, without claiming execution of the RIB decision process or new runtime proof.
